$comment: The project's own facts for the ai_tooling engine (lib/AgentSetup.psm1, setup.ps1,
verify-agent-setup.ps1), which is the same in every project set up from the blueprint.
name           the project's name, shown by setup.ps1 and in generated notes.
skillPrefixes  the prefixes of the project's own skills and subagents, lowercase:
skills may not start with one, and setup removes a subagent with such a
prefix from a copied subagents folder once it is gone from agents/. The
first one is the main prefix ({prefix}-aitooling-maintain, {prefix}-role-*).
A second one is for a product family with its own apps in the same
name: Watch Face Total View
